sourceAuthority: Atlas source index is derived from the user-designated authoritative PPTX; source Hanzi and pinyin strings are preserved verbatim.

method.scope: All Atlas pinyin syllable occurrences indexed from the 14 vocabulary slides.
method.normalization: Tone marks are removed only for matching; the original pinyinAsDisplayed value is preserved in every occurrence.
method.analysis: Distinguishes phonological zero initials from orthographic y/w markers; restores j/q/x + u to ü; expands iu/ui/un abbreviations to iou/uei/uen (except j/q/x + un = ün); identifies apical i after z/c/s/zh/ch/sh/r; identifies candidate medial-plus-final structures.
method.pedagogicalCaution: The structural analysis is a coverage aid, not a verdict on the lesson content. PIN-14/15 teaching classifications must be checked against the original lesson text. The package contains placeholders, not full lesson bodies.
method.limits: No full course-body text is present in this package. Therefore no course-level coverage item is marked taught, missing, or accepted.
method.courseInterpretation: The 22 consonant-initial medial structures are candidate three-part syllables for PIN-15 review. The 8 zero-initial y/w forms are not ordinary consonant-initial three-part syllables; review their orthographic spelling under PIN-17 while checking the underlying medial-final pattern.
